open.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production game sprite, a small charming sage green pond frog for a warm fairytale miniature garden game. Soft sculpted hand-painted 3D appearance, subtle moss green speckles and cream belly, round glossy dark expressive eyes, four neatly formed small feet, friendly closed mouth. Three-quarter frontal view, viewed from slightly above, complete seated squat body fully visible. Gentle warm upper-left lighting and softly modeled volume, crisp clean silhouette, no thick outlines. Only ONE frog, centered, generous transparent margins. No lily pad, plants, accessories, ground plane, cast shadow, halo, text or scenery. Genuine transparent background. Maintain simple readable rounded silhouette suitable for a small gameplay prop; sophisticated texture rather than flat vector colored shapes.

closed.prompt: Edit this frog sprite into its blink animation frame. Change ONLY the eyes to gently closed lids, with a curved subtle eyelid seam. Preserve EXACT canvas dimensions, body silhouette, every foot position, camera, size, texture, palette, lighting and transparent background. No new objects. The open-eye and closed-eye sprites must register seamlessly with no body movement.

note: Original PNG bytes retained, including alpha. AtlasTexture crops at runtime; no image postprocessing. Existing 24 reference-pixel frog width and 44x21 pad retained.
